svg.title: Editable RAPTOR logo with a simplified ARGOS-inspired minimal rocket
svg.desc: Editable RAPTOR badge with live typography, a segmented inner ring, planet, stars and trajectory. The former spacecraft has been replaced by a compact five-shape rocket inspired by the ARGOS-LAB vehicle: a white stage body, dark inner frame, paired fins, nose bands and a red-orange exhaust flame.
